Next planned Artemis mission (post-Artemis I), based on NASA’s Artemis II mission page:

- Mission name: Artemis II
- Planned launch year: 2026 (launched April 1, 2026 per NASA’s mission summary)
- Destination: Lunar flyby around the Moon
- Primary objective: The first crewed Artemis flight and a crewed lunar flyby that marks a key step toward a long‑term return to the Moon and future missions to Mars, paving the way for future lunar surface missions.

Source: NASA – Artemis II: NASA’s First Crewed Lunar Flyby in 50 Years (https://www.nasa.gov/mission/artemis-ii/), which describes Artemis II as “The first crewed Artemis flight” and a “Crewed Lunar Flyby,” with launch listed as April 1, 2026 and notes that it “marks a key step toward long‑term return to the Moon and future missions to Mars.”
